usage.callShape: GET https://api.signalfuse.co/v1/sentiment/{symbol} (x402, $0.002 USDC on Base). Registered URL is /sentiment/BTC.
usage.outputShape: On success (per advertised example only): body.symbol, body.label, body.confidence, body.score, body.updated_at. NOT OBSERVED — the registered BTC call returns body.detail (error string) with HTTP 400.
quirks: CHARGE-THEN-ERROR: pays $0.002 USDC then returns HTTP 400 for the registered /BTC URL — money lost with no result.

Registry schema and description are WRONG: they advertise crypto symbols (BTC/ETH/SOL/DOGE/PEPE/WIF/BONK/ARB/OP/AVAX) and call it 'BTC/crypto social sentiment', but the LIVE API only supports US STOCK tickers.
Live API supported symbols (from the 400 error): TSLA, PLTR, BABA, HOOD, NVDA, AMZN, META, GOOGL.
The registered call path (/sentiment/BTC) is the broken one; a valid call would need a stock ticker like /sentiment/NVDA (untested — second payment was blocked by money-safety scope).
usage.guide: Do NOT call the registered URL https://api.signalfuse.co/v1/sentiment/BTC — it charges $0.002 USDC and then returns HTTP 400 'Unknown symbol: BTC' because the live API does not support crypto symbols at all. The registry/service metadata is incorrect: this endpoint actually serves US-stock social sentiment, supporting only TSLA, PLTR, BABA, HOOD, NVDA, AMZN, META, GOOGL. To possibly get a result you would call GET /v1/sentiment/{stock_ticker} (e.g. /sentiment/NVDA), which per the advertised example returns JSON {symbol, label, confidence, score, updated_at}; this success path was NOT verified here. As registered, treat this endpoint as broken/mismatched.
